assets.name: 军用物资箱
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE replacement world-container sprite for the high-angle top-down pixel-art game 潮汐线. Subject: a heavy MILITARY SUPPLY CRATE, NOT a communications instrument case. Authentic coarse48x48 pixel art, simplified realistic low-saturation retro-industrial post-disaster materials, readable big hard square clusters, 16-20 restrained colors, clear silhouette suited to dark grey-green terrain. Camera75degrees ABOVE HORIZONTAL, orthographic grid alignment, top surface dominant about70%, SOUTH short front face30%, small darker right edge. Upper-left light. Box is rectangular, low, squat, sturdy and heavy: dark olive-green and grey-green steel body, slightly broad flat lid, chunky silver-grey metal corner guards, two clearly visible metal latches on front lip, reinforced hinge ends. Sparse chipped paint, scuffed edges and old handling wear. A small simple ivory stencilled SUPPLY SYMBOL on top, e.g. abstract box-outline with two short bars; no readable letters, numbers, brand logo or UI text. One short folded khaki canvas strap and a tiny worn tag near side handle, kept attached close to the body, no loose cable or antenna. Prioritize standardized army storage for ammunition, equipment and military supplies. Fixed top brighter / front midtone / side dark; top edges horizontal and depth edges vertical, not diamond isometric, no perspective convergence. Whole intact closed crate centered inside42x42 area of48x48 canvas, >=3px genuine transparent padding. No floor, scene, shadow, people, weapons, loose ammo, bright saturated colors, glowing effects, sci-fi details or UI. Reference1 is original container for scale and pixel-series style only; redesign the geometry/material as a military supply crate. Reference2 defines project camera.
assets.processing: alpha crop; nearest-neighbour contain; binary alpha; 16-color quantization
